Read the page, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna Price Tracker

Track prices in one tap. Your phone will check the price for you every day. Get notified when the price drops. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to. And there's a whole family of Luna apps so you can do more in Safari.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna Price Tracker
